name: fabflows
description: Routes mechanical work from an expensive lead model to cheaper, tool-scoped worker agents -- explorer and researcher on Haiku, editor and test-runner on Sonnet -- and makes the lead re-verify what they report instead of trusting it. Ships an ACTIVE guard hook that blocks package installs, commits and pushes to a default branch, destructive shell commands, and reads or writes of credential files; the guard fails open, so a bug degrades to no guard rather than a blocked session.
